purpose: Forecast aggregated venue demand only when future error and uncertainty improve the governed day-hour baseline.
limitations: Forecasts are aggregate associations and do not identify individual intent.
Conformal coverage is empirical and can degrade after temporal or marketplace drift.
Synthetic improvement never authorizes production promotion.
The auditable day-hour baseline remains active whenever any gate fails.
rollback: Disable the boosting forecast and restore the hourly occupancy and demand baseline with its published uncertainty.
